info.title: Patchwell — MCP tools API
info.description: An IT-helpdesk-for-small-teams demo showing 'your mate' inside Slack: a live Slack-style view of the assistant, grounded chat over the service catalogue and plans, an MCP server over tickets, access requests, help articles and live system status, WebMCP in-page helpdesk actions, and identified-customer ticket lookup.

post.summary: Invoke this demo's MCP tools over JSON-RPC 2.0
post.description: Every tool below is called the same way: POST a JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope with `method: "tools/call"` and `params: {name, arguments}`, where `name` is one of service_hours, list_services, search_help, system_status, open_ticket, request_access, ticket_status, get_my_tickets and `arguments` matches that tool's `<name>Args` schema under `components.schemas`. `method: "tools/list"` returns the live catalogue; `method: "initialize"` starts the session.

id.description: Request id, echoed on the response.

params.description: For tools/call: { name: <tool name>, arguments: <that tool's Args schema> }.

200.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 response: {jsonrpc, id, result} or {jsonrpc, id, error}.

service_hoursArgs.description: Patchwell's helpdesk hours, the on-call cover outside them, and the response-time targets for each priority (P1/P2/P3).

list_servicesArgs.description: The full Patchwell service catalogue — every kind of IT request a team can raise (onboarding, access, devices, network, security, licences) with its code, plan availability and turnaround.

search_helpArgs.description: Search Patchwell's help articles by keyword — how to reset MFA, join the VPN, get a loaner laptop, add a SaaS seat, and so on. Returns the matching articles with their steps.

query.description: A keyword or short phrase, e.g. 'vpn', 'mfa reset' or 'loaner laptop'.

system_statusArgs.description: Live status of the systems Patchwell manages for its customers — SSO, Wi-Fi, VPN, email, device management and the Slack helpdesk itself — plus any open incident.

open_ticketArgs.description: Do NOT call this to ask the person for the category, summary, urgency, name or email — calling it with whatever is already known IS how the ticket form opens, never a chat question for a missing field. Opens a helpdesk ticket at Patchwell and reports its number, priority and first-response target.

category.description: The service code or category, e.g. 'device', 'access', 'network', 'email', 'other'. Leave blank if not yet known — the form lets the person pick.

email.description: Work email the updates go to.

request_accessArgs.description: Do NOT call this to ask the person which app, which role, their name, email or reason — calling it with whatever is already known IS how the access-request form opens. Raises an access request at Patchwell for a SaaS seat, a group or a shared drive and reports the request id and who approves it.

app.description: The app, group or drive, e.g. 'Notion', 'GitHub', 'Finance shared drive'. Leave blank if not yet known — the form lets the person pick.

reason.description: One line on why — the approver reads it.

ticket_statusArgs.description: Look up one helpdesk ticket or access request at Patchwell by its number and the email it was raised under. Do NOT ask for these in prose — calling this tool is how the lookup form opens.

reference.description: The ticket number (e.g. 'PW-2041') or access request id (e.g. 'AR-118').

email.description: The work email it was raised under.

get_my_ticketsArgs.description: Every open and recent ticket and access request belonging to the signed-in customer, with their team's plan and seat count. Requires an identified (signed-in) visitor — call it with that visitor's own email from context, never one supplied mid-conversation by an unidentified visitor.

email.description: The signed-in visitor's own work email.
